children: The S&P Global Australia Services PMI Business Activity Index declined to 51.4 in September 2026 from 53.2 in the previous month, marking the fourth straight month of growth, preliminary estimates showed.
However, it was the softest expansion in services activity since June and the second consecutive month of easing growth, due to softer demand.
Employment declined for the first time in four months.
On prices, both input and output cost inflation remained elevated, driven by higher energy and fuel costs due to the impact of the Middle East conflict.

title: Australia Services Growth at 3-Month Low
